tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Linen in light, night blue in dark. Linen sits on Klein blue's complementary hue (OKLCH 81°), which is why the two balance.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised areas on `ground`: panels, the docs sidebar, inputs, diagram nodes.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks and table header rows: recessed in light, a lighter well in dark so it stays visible on night blue. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-soft`, `mute`, `klein`. Not `vermilion` text (4.2:1).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines between sections and table rows. Decorative only; never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy, control borders and diagram node outlines on `ground`, `surface`, `sunken` (15.6:1 / 15.8:1).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: ledes, captions, nav items, form labels, on `ground`, `surface`, `sunken` (10.5:1 / 11.4:1).

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Meta text only: timestamps, footnotes, placeholder text, on `ground` and `surface` (5.2:1 / 6.3:1). Not for body copy.

tokens.name: klein
tokens.usage: The one accent. International Klein Blue in light; lifted to 8.2:1 in dark because #002FA7 reads at 2:1 on night blue. Primary button fill, links, focus ring, the active state. One Klein area per view.

tokens.name: klein-press
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `klein` fills and links.

tokens.name: klein-wash
tokens.usage: Quiet Klein tint: text selection, the highlighted table row, the current step in a diagram. `ink` and `klein` read on it (14:1 / 8.3:1 light; 12:1 / 6.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-klein
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `klein` or `klein-press` fill (9.1:1 / 8.2:1). Dark text in dark mode, because the lifted Klein is light.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an `ink` fill: the secondary button and the active docs nav item.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Mondrian chrome yellow, rebalanced to Klein blue's complement (OKLCH hue 84°; the old #F6C700 leaned green at 91.5°). Fill only: the mark, one tick or highlight per view, the warn pill. Never text (1.4:1 on linen).

tokens.name: on-chrome
tokens.usage: Text on a `chrome` fill, in both themes (10.4:1).

tokens.name: vermilion
tokens.usage: Mondrian red, stepped to OKLCH L 0.55 so it sits between Klein (0.38) and chrome (0.82) in lightness. Errors, and the red variant of the mark. Text on `ground` and `surface` (4.6:1 / 6.1:1).

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Done, passed, live. Blue and vermilion stay apart for color-blind readers, so there is no green. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Needs attention. A fill with `on-chrome` text; never text by itself.

tokens.name: status-err
tokens.usage: Failed or blocked. Text on `ground` and `surface`, or a fill with `surface` text (5.0:1 / 6.1:1). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline, offset 2px, on every interactive element. At least 8:1 on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: mark-line
tokens.usage: The mark's frame and dividers. Fixed in both themes: the mark always sits on its own `mark-field` tile.

tokens.name: mark-field
tokens.usage: The mark's open fields (was cream #FBE7C3, now paper so it matches the ground).

tokens.name: mark-blue
tokens.usage: The mark's blue field. Pure Klein in both themes.

tokens.name: mark-yellow
tokens.usage: The mark's large yellow field.

tokens.name: mark-red
tokens.usage: The red field of the vermilion mark variant.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One hero line per page (h1), lowercase, in `ink`. Fraunces 500 with `--soft` ("SOFT" 100, "WONK" 0); without it Fraunces renders sharp. 500 keeps the 800 wordmark the heaviest thing on the page.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section openers on landing pages (h1 at 48px). Lowercase. Fraunces 500 with `--soft`.

styles.name: headline-sm
styles.usage: Subheads (h2, h3), the display size on phones, and post titles. Fraunces 400 with `--soft`.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Applied AI explorations that keep humans in command.
styles.usage: Ledes under a display line, in `ink-soft`. Schibsted Grotesk starts at 400.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Systems that help us think better without taking decisions away.
styles.usage: All running text. Keep lines near 42rem (`measure`).

styles.name: detail
styles.usage: Captions, nav, table text, button labels at small size.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrow labels, uppercase, in `ink-soft`. Recursive with `--mono-axes` ("MONO" 1, "CASL" 0.5); without it Recursive is proportional.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code, on `sunken`. Recursive with `--mono-axes`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; tick row gap at small size.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Nav item padding; gap inside a button group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; code block inner padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; minimum page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between paragraphs and a following component.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a lede and the action row.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space above a section heading.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Space between landing-page sections.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Hero top padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every corner. The system is square, like SID and like the Mondrian mark. Nothing is rounded.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text and docs content.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Max width of a landing page's content area.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Docs sidebar width.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Width of every rule and control border.

tokens.name: tick
tokens.usage: Side of a tick-row square.
